Classify or validate exact CA20g014 source nonresponse

Source: R/liss_source_nonresponse_ca20g014.R
liss_classify_ca20g014.Rd

Read only the complete reviewed ca20g_EN_1.0p.sav source and classify the exact ca20g014 codes -9 and -8. A separately pinned authority and whole-result carrier are version 1.0.0. The question asks the guaranteed minimum payout of single-premium or life annuity insurance, or the savings amount of endowment insurance on 2019-12-31, in whole EUR. The amount reference date is distinct from September and October 2020 collection. Household and financial-role instructions distinguish own assets from own plus joint assets; no uniform household total, market or surrender value, or income is asserted.

Usage

liss_classify_ca20g014(source)

liss_validate_ca20g014(result, source = NULL)

Arguments

source

path to the exact reviewed local SAV file. Required for classification; optional for additional complete-source consistency validation.

result

complete result returned by liss_classify_ca20g014().

Value

Classification returns a guarded closed list with original_data, analysis, data, source_nonresponse and source_nonresponse_readiness. analysis contains data and ledger. Validation invisibly returns valid, validation, source_consistency, classified_cells, source_readiness, source_authentication and statistical_validity; the last two are FALSE.

Details

Creation checks filename, byte size and SHA-256 before and after import. Haven parses the in-memory byte buffer whose exact size and hash were checked, with user_na = TRUE and minimal name repair. The complete imported tibble, all columns and metadata, and original row order remain in original_data. Only the exact negative pair becomes ordinary NA in separate analysis$data. Retained source labels and missing declarations describe the original source; they do not attest changed analysis values. Top-level data duplicates the marked analysis frame. The typed analysis$ledger binds source hash, original row ordinal and raw field, preserving key, original code, case, unknown subtype, missing-amount disposition and no-numeric-proposal flag. Coverage lists every source row. Readiness concerns the two encodings, not overall amount validity.

SAV positive ten-digit missing declarations AND value labels differ from the codebook's positive eleven-digit forms. The negative pair is undeclared. No sign/digit repair or authenticated don't-know/refusal mapping follows. Target 9999999998, 9999999999, 99999999998 or 99999999999 makes classification and validation reject the whole call with liss_ca20g014_blocked; no partial result is returned. Positive 8 and 9 are ordinary preserved amounts. Every nonmatch stays exact and uncertified, including other negatives, either zero sign, fractions, out-of-range and nonfinite payloads. The documented 1..999999999 domain is descriptive, not enforced. Unknown subtype remains nonresponse_unknown with unresolved evidence; no numerical proposal or overall amount-validity claim is made.

Coded rows require finite, nonmissing possession gate ca20g005 = 1. Noncoded rows need not satisfy that gate; eligible source-missing answers remain missing. Exact ordered ID/014/005 metadata are admission requirements. The ca20g015 column is required by the complete schema, but its metadata reference hash is contextual only. The record carries reference and actual attribute digests separately with required_for_admission = FALSE; equality between those hashes is not an admission condition. Missing follow-up values, including on coded rows, are allowed. No amount, midpoint, sign, donor or authenticated subtype is inferred from its categories. All 65 other columns, including ca20g012, ca20g016, ca20g023 and ca20g015, remain exact. The three older standalone authorities remain separate and unchanged.

Validation requires the complete closed result and reconstructs it against the complete retained original. With source = NULL, this checks structural consistency only. Supplying source additionally rereads verified bytes and compares the entire imported original, including every non-target column and metadata. R identity AND version-2 serialized payload equality are required, including numeric payloads, reference identity and attribute order. Analysis guard placement is normalized while marker/readiness values remain checked. Whole-result RDS preserves the object; validation across R or package versions is not guaranteed. Ordinary hashes do not authenticate origin: a consistently substituted original/result can pass structure. Source mode detects a mismatch with the trusted file; neither mode establishes statistical validity.

Existing collection claims support denial only. They grant no CI carrier, rebinding, income/wealth cleaning, applied-view, background, panel, report or SAV/CSV export capability. Explicit correct or na_only cleaner rejection can evaluate background while checking its required NULL value. Rejection does not promise every caller expression remains unevaluated. Complete claim stripping or extracting unmarked originals leaves unknown ownership; aliases cannot recover it. No combined CA carrier is defined. Default CA recipe/B03, numerical methods and complete CI parent/view lineage are unchanged. No other field or release is covered.
